Title: Il viaggio all'Indie Orientali del P. F. Vincenzo Maria di S. Caterina da Siena, Procuratore Generale de' Carmelitani Scalzi, con le osservationi e successi nel medesimo, i costumi e riti di varie nationi, et reconditissimi arcani de' gentili, cavati con somma diligenza da' loro scritti, con la descrittione degli animali quadrupedi, serpenti, uccelli e piante di quel mondo nuovo, diviso in cinque libri
Creator: Vincenzo Maria di S. Caterina da Siena (Vincenzo Maria Murchio), O.C.D., Discalced Carmelite, companion of Giuseppe di S. Maria Sebastiani on the first Carmelite mission to the St. Thomas Christians of Malabar, 1656-1658 (first-person account)
Publisher: In Roma: Nella Stamperia di Filippomaria Mancini
Publication Date: 1672 (colophon at the end of the volume 'Nella Stamperia di Filippo M. Mancini. 1672'; the host catalogue gives 1672 as the first edition)
Rights: Public Domain (published 1672, more than 95 years before 2026; public domain by date)
Language: ita
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_NC9W3W6xXFAC, file bub_gb_NC9W3W6xXFAC_djvu.txt (Google scan of the National Central Library of Rome copy), fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (Public Domain Mark 1.0); no possible-copyright-status field.
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged apart from this header (no long-s characters present; the OCR renders the seventeenth-century long s as 'f' throughout and that pattern is left as found; nothing retyped, dropped or corrected). Rights basis restated in one checkable sentence: the colophon inside this file reads 'Nella Stamperia di Filippo M. Mancini. 1672', so the work is public domain by date.
Content note: Italian throughout. Five books, with a table of chapters at the front: Libro Primo, the journey out through the Levant, Mesopotamia and Persia to India; Libro Secondo, the Christians of St. Thomas (their origin, the memory of the Apostle, their history to 1599, their reduction to the Catholic faith, their customs, civil government and church order, their relapse into schism and the state in which the mission found them, and chapters 9-25 on the negotiations of 1657-1658 with the Archdeacon and the assemblies at Mattancherry, Mangate and St. Thomas); Libro Terzo, India and its peoples, castes and Brahmin religion; Libro Quarto, plants and animals; Libro Quinto, the return. Book Two is the part that serves the Malabar entries: a Carmelite eyewitness account, hostile to the Archdeacon's party, that also records the community's customs and its own account of its origins. OCR sampled at 10/30/50/70/90 percent and found readable but rough (share of word-like tokens 0.83); a second scan of the same edition (bub_gb_4r9d70sca7kC) sampled slightly worse, and a 1678 Venice edition (bub_gb_HZqanJ2PxGgC) exists. Second witness for exact wording until a passage is checked against the page images. No public-domain English translation is known to exist (archive.org searched 2026-10-16: none found).
